en.groups.permissionScope: Changes this group root and newly spawned Bot tasks. Running tasks keep their existing permissions; Bot tool and data restrictions still apply.
en.groups.permissionLoadFailed: Access modes could not be loaded.
en.groups.permissionSaveFailed: Access mode could not be changed. Choose a mode again to retry.
en.groups.permissionFullConfirmDescription: Full access reduces confirmation steps and allows sensitive operations, file changes and external commands. This affects the group root and new Bot tasks. Existing Bot tool and data restrictions still apply. Only enable it when you trust the current task.
en.groups.permissionAutoConfirmDescription: Auto review runs without a sandbox. The current agent's model reviews native tool calls and PTC inner calls; you approve or reject calls it denies. It can falsely allow or deny actions and uses additional tokens. This affects the group root and new Bot tasks; Bot tool and data restrictions still apply.
en.groups.permissionAcknowledge: I understand these risks and want to continue

zh.groups.permissionScope: 调整当前群主会话及之后启动的 Bot 任务。运行中的任务保留原权限；Bot 工具与数据限制仍然有效。
zh.groups.permissionSaveFailed: 访问模式修改失败。可重新选择模式重试。
zh.groups.permissionFullConfirmDescription: 完全权限会减少确认步骤，允许敏感操作、文件修改和外部命令。此次调整影响群主会话及之后启动的 Bot 任务；Bot 工具与数据限制仍然有效。请仅在信任当前任务时启用。
zh.groups.permissionAutoConfirmTitle: 确认启用自动审查（实验）？
zh.groups.permissionAutoConfirmDescription: 自动审查不使用沙箱。当前智能体所用的模型会审查每次原生工具与 PTC 内层调用；审查拒绝的调用由你批准或拒绝。它可能误放行或误拒绝，并消耗额外 token。此次调整影响群主会话及之后启动的 Bot 任务；Bot 工具与数据限制仍然有效。
zh.groups.permissionAcknowledge: 我已了解这些风险，并愿意继续
